title: Node 侧三重锁 — .nvmrc + .npmrc + packageManager SHA512
description:
Node 工程环境硬锁, 让 clone 后 `pnpm i` (或 npm i) 必然命中 CI 相同环境.

1. 添加 `.nvmrc` 内容为固定 Node 版本 (e.g. 22.11.0, 跟 rust-toolchain 风格对齐).
2. 添加/更新 `node/.npmrc`:
   ```
   node-linker=hoisted
   frozen-lockfile=true
   engine-strict=true
   ```
3. 在 node/package.json 添加 `packageManager` 字段带 SHA512:
   `"packageManager": "pnpm@X.Y.Z+sha512:<hash>"` (或 npm@ 对应哈希).
4. Cargo 侧 rust-toolchain.toml 补一致的 channel + components pin (如已存在则 verify).

Cindy 参考: apps/desktop 用 `packageManager: pnpm@10.33.2+sha512:...` + `.npmrc` 3 行.
acceptance: .nvmrc 存在, 内容为版本号单行
node/package.json packageManager 字段带 +sha512 后缀
CI 从零 clone 环境 `node -v` == .nvmrc 内容
刻意改 .nvmrc 为错版本 → CI FAIL (engine-strict 生效)

verification.rust_toolchain_toml_state: created new file (did not exist before) — channel=1.97.1, components=[rustfmt, clippy, rust-src], profile=minimal
verification.package_manager_detected: pnpm@10.13.1 (no lockfile at node/ root — followed KALLAX doc convention preferring pnpm)
notes: Format uses +sha512.<base64> (dot) per corepack spec matching Cindy pnpm@10.33.2+sha512:... pattern
Node 22.11.0 as ticket description specified as LTS baseline
